note: atlas-p0-caw-1126: Boundless Atlas package P0 on worlds that Create a World made at 4096 m (its docs/017; Rodney 2026-11-26 lifted the no-large-world-loads rule for the P0 loads). NOT RUN: prepared and dry-run only; the band rerun has the game and this branch waits for its rule review. Why these worlds: the generated thin 4096 / 8192 m worlds crash at 0xC2C1B5 because the paint header 0x9063660D still lists the template's 64 terrain cell records (only its size fields were grown); CAW writes all 256 records, a 4096 x 4096 paint map and the blend-layer id grid, so the game takes the cached path and the crashing pass does not run. Correctness / discovery, no timing claim; each load time is one sample. Bin state apex (tools/turbo-compat.ts snapshot -> state apex -> restore). The ASI B1 patch is OFF in every job (PhysicsRootM=0: 4096 m fits the physics root); B5 is Default.ini SceneQuadTree=4096,512,7. PREP (game closed, all outside git): boundless-atlas `native\atlas\build.cmd`, copy out\atlas.asi to <s3m>/game-copy/atlas-main3/atlas.asi (0.1.1-p0, sha256 in each job); `node tools/world-pack.ts pack probe-out/caw/create-4096-<stamp>/Atlas4096.world <s3m>/game-copy/worlds/p0/AtlasCawFlat_4096.world`; for job 2 first `node tools/caw/caw-run.ts tools/caw/jobs/stitched-4096-lots.json`, then pack its Stitched4096L.world to AtlasCawStitchedL_4096.world; back up <Documents>/Electronic Arts/The Sims 3; `node tools/world-gen.ts install <each world>` (copies to InstalledWorlds). AFTER: `node tools/world-gen.ts install <each> --uninstall`. Each job: menu -> load_world (LiveMode) -> in_world -> about 2 min of camera poses (origin quadrant, far corner, far x and z edges) -> quit. Read from the job log: load step time, memory lines (commit / private / largest free MB per step), script errors (scriptErrorsMax 0), crash / hang capture, the three atlas.log lines and the Default.ini read-back line. Kill criteria (Atlas docs/008): a load failure two triage rounds cannot name, or largest free under about 1.2 GB after the load. No bisect on a failure: static triage first. Job 3 is the generator route (thin 4096 m with the uniform id grid, Atlas docs/017 §2.5): PREP `node tools/world-empty.ts build "<s3m>/game-copy/worlds/Sunset Valley.world" <s3m>/game-copy/worlds/p0/AtlasP0thinU_4096.world --size 4096 --thin --uniform-grid`, install as above. 8192 m is not in this queue: CAW cannot make that size yet (Atlas docs/017 §4). Read-backs added 2026-11-26 (rule review): queue.ts logs each merged Default.ini key as read back from the file; atlas.asi 0.1.1-p0 logs the scene quadtree the renderer built (root size and depth; its pointer chain is [inferred], Atlas docs/017 §5, so a miss on that one line with everything else passing is the read-back, not the world).
